emails.subject: Important: your data is at risk and will be deleted in 30 days.
emails.snippet: Your MEGA account is still locked as it has been over its storage limit for more than 40 days. A locked account means you are unable to download, upload or delete data.
emails.reason: Storage limit has been exceeded for 40+ days; MEGA says the account's data gets deleted in 30 days if untouched.

emails.snippet: We've noticed we are still unable to process your next order. Here's a link to update your billing information so we can get your order processed right away.
emails.reason: A recurring order's billing failed and hasn't reprocessed since Aug 7 — worth a look if this subscription still matters.
